source: working tree after PB3 plus the adjacent-deposit change (Editor Play, 2026-11-18, Claude)
driver: Unity MCP Input System key events from a worker thread through the isolated launcher in the main editor; real GameBootstrap Play, fresh world, world-map travel from Overworld.11.10.0 to the wild zone Overworld.10.11.0
disclosures: The camp box was GRANTED to the pack with execute_code (the Quartermaster sale path is covered by native tests; no Quartermaster stock was rolled in play). All verbs after that used real keys and the ordinary menus.

F12 was not used. The first F5 happened in a session that the editor then recompiled under (source edits made during Play); that session was stopped and the checkpoint was Continued in a fresh launch.
Input stopped reaching the game once while the Game view lost focus (Application.isFocused false); focusing the Game view restored it. Not a game defect.
A viper and a magpie fought nearby in the zone for the whole session; the player was never attacked and HP stayed 40.
The box draws as its glyph (no art ships with it).
The hearth play also needed the Game view focused again (Application.isFocused false) and a new-game prompt answered with N because the launcher root held an earlier save.

observations.arrival_zone_choice: The classifier showed most zones near the start are family-owned or protected (a 5x5 window around 11.10: 3 wild, 11 family-owned, 6 protected, 2 POI). The nearest wild zone was 10.11, reached by the world map.
observations.refusal_on_road: At the arrival cell 40,12 (RoadStone) the pack menu listed 'set down (unavailable)' and selecting it logged 'The ground here will not hold it.' (setdown-disabled-on-road.png)
observations.set_down: On grass at 40,9 the pack menu listed eight 'set down <direction>' rows (setdown-rows-on-grass.png); set down north: 'You set camp box down.', pack weight 24 to 12, CampBox#2707 at 40,8 solid=True takeable=False Owned marker Player/RetainZone Installed tick 100 (after-setdown.png)
observations.world_menu_and_reader: Interact north: open, take up, break, hand over (you can no longer take it up), examine (standing-box-menu.png). Examine CURRENT STATE: 'You set this down. It stays here, with whatever is in it. You can take it up again, or hand it over and leave it for good.' (standing-box-reader.png)
observations.walk_away_and_save: Walked 12 cells east and back, F5 at turn 350; the box stayed at 40,8 with its marker.
observations.fresh_continue: AfterSaveCheckpoint restaged into a new launcher root and Continued: CampBox#2707 at 40,8 solid, marker Player, SetTick 100, same entity ID.
observations.deposit: A solid box cannot be stood on and the pack menu only offered 'Put in' for a container at the player's feet, so the first attempt offered nothing. After the adjacent-deposit change the dagger's actions listed 'Put in camp box' and it went in: Dagger#2701 inside, box weight 16 (12 + 4), pack weight 12 to 8 (put-in-camp-box-row.png)
observations.take_up: World menu take up with the dagger inside: CampBox#2707 in the pack, contents=1, weight 16, takeable, not solid, marker released, none left in the zone.
observations.hand_over: Set down east to 41,9 then hand over: marker released, Owned tag cleared, still standing solid with contents=1 (standing-box-menu-before-handover.png).
observations.camp_hearth_play: Second Editor play (fresh world, same method; CampHearth, CampBench, 2 SalvagedTimber and a RecoveredIronBlank were GRANTED with execute_code). In the wild zone 10.11 the pack menu listed eight 'set down <direction>' rows for the hearth (camp-hearth-setdown-rows.png); set down east: 'You set camp hearth down.' The standing hearth's world menu listed take up, 'feed coals (1 salvaged timber, up to 10 fuel)', hand over, examine (camp-hearth-standing-menu.png). Feed: 'You feed one salvaged timber to the coals. The fuel still needs flame.' fuel 0 to 10, temperature 25, light off. Casting Ember Spit at it ('Your ember drops camp hearth!') did NOT light it (temperature stayed 25, tile heat 0): relighting needs an existing flame (a lit equipped torch or a hot neighbour), as the shipped coals do, so the first flame must be carried from a village fire. The bench was not played; its process rows are native-tested through the real station contract.

not_exercised: rest or a long clock jump away from the box
a relapsing village (set-down is refused in villages; native retention tests cover marker retention there)
